objective: Prepare the human-requested v2.0.0 major software release by synchronizing every distributable version declaration, documenting only capabilities merged into main, and preserving the existing simulation, hardware and safety evidence boundaries.
forbidden: runtime behavior changes beyond the reported software version
claims of Gazebo, physical robot, procurement, certification, or hardware release readiness
hand-editing any generated block between BEGIN GENERATED and END GENERATED markers
acceptance: all distributable package and health-endpoint version metadata reports 2.0.0
English and Chinese READMEs identify v2.0.0 as the current software release and describe only capabilities merged into main
README evidence boundaries keep scripted fixtures, Gazebo, MoveIt execution, camera, BSP image, and physical hardware claims separate
deployment examples reference the v2.0.0 image tag
the release diff excludes every open pull request
every generated release block is regenerated by its own script rather than edited by hand
repository required checks pass before tagging
evidence: phase gate regeneration and check output
published v2.0.0 tag and GitHub Release URL
stop_conditions: the human owner has not explicitly requested publication
main changes after release validation and before tagging
a required check or release-image job fails
release notes would require an unmerged or ineligible physical claim
a version declaration outside the allowed paths still reports the previous release
